nl: In the registry key HKCU\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4, set the DWORD value Level to 6 and add the string value Mode with the data fast.

setup.description: The registry key HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4 exists with the values Level, Theme.
setup.pwsh:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4' -Name 'Level' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4' -Name 'Theme' -PropertyType String -Value 'dark' -Force | Out-Null

oracle_program:
write "registry:/HKCU/Software/NurtBench/Viewer4/Level" 6 value_type: dword mode: overwrite
write "registry:/HKCU/Software/NurtBench/Viewer4/Mode" "fast" value_type: string mode: create
reference_pwsh:
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4' -Name Level -Value 6 -Type DWord
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Viewer4' -Name Mode -PropertyType String -Value 'fast' | Out-Null
